bullets: Build deep buyer insight. Understand how self-funded employers, health plans, and their advisers evaluate, buy, and implement imaging benefits. ashby:temporal:01e59346-2cf2-4123-8df1-c.summary:
Temporal is used by a lot of companies in a wide variety of contexts. Many use Temporal Cloud. Many others users don’t yet know about Temporal Cloud, believe self-hosting is cheaper, and/or just don’t yet see a need to move. Still others (often happily using Temporal Cloud at large scale) also operate environments where a managed service isn't an option today and may never be, like:

This role owns understanding the world of Temporal usage outside Cloud, what the different contexts demand, and where Temporal should (and shouldn't) engage. That includes what we build, what we support, what we charge for, and what we leave alone. You'll shape which offerings we pursue and how they make money or contribute to the larger business. Then you'll take the ones we commit to through launch and adoption.

sections.title: Role Summary
paras: Open source Temporal is central to this. We’re investing heavily in OSS, from performance improvements to easier management to clearer guidance on compatibility and cost. When companies write their apps on Temporal, they’re making a huge bet on us, and that trust is sacred. A large part of this role is improving and shepherding how we keep making OSS better.
bullets: AI and application companies embedding Temporal inside software their own customers run in isolated, air-gapped environments, or offering a remote management BYOA posture
Large enterprises keeping operational control of critical systems in-house by policy
Companies operating in sovereign clouds and similar contexts where legal or organizational requirements make outside management difficult or impossible

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Map usage outside Temporal Cloud. Build the company's clearest picture of where Temporal runs outside Cloud and why. Separate structural constraints (air gaps, regulation, owning operational risk) from cost, inertia, and/or other factors. Turn that into segments and use cases leadership can make decisions with.

Decide what we pursue. Recommend which needs deserve new offerings, which Temporal Cloud should cover, and which we deliberately leave alone. Write the case, defend it, and revisit it when the evidence changes.

Define the line between open source and paid. Set clear guidelines for which improvements and support go into open source Temporal, and where paid offerings take over. Keep the open source experience strong, and make the line easy for users and internal teams to understand.

Define the business model. Work with leadership, Sales, and Finance on packaging, pricing, and how we sell offerings that run outside our infrastructure. Know what customers will pay for and what it costs us to support it.
Help Cloud win where it should. Work with other PMs so workloads that can run on Cloud move there more easily, with a clear value and TCO case.
Lead without authority. Align Engineering, Resident Architects, Dev Success, Security, and go-to-market teams, including when their incentives conflict.
Own outcomes. Define success in terms of adoption, revenue, and retention. Use the results to steer further investment.

Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

paras: Mozilla Accounts is central to Firefox’s future—a platform that delivers seamless, privacy-respecting authentication and security while unlocking value across our ecosystem of products and services. We are evolving Mozilla Accounts into a frictionless access layer that powers cross-device engagement and growth through Sync, while connecting users to services like VPN, Relay, and emerging AI-powered experiences like Smart Window. paras:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a Senior or Staff Product Manager to own and scale Nova Credit’s Rentals vertical. Over the past five-plus years, Nova Credit has processed millions of income verifications for thousands of property management companies — and this role owns the product strategy at the center of that business, spanning across all four of our products today: Income Navigator, Eligibility Compass, Credit Passport, and Cash Atlas.

This is an opportunity to own a vertical end-to-end: setting product strategy, building the roadmap, and shipping products that help housing providers verify applicants faster and more accurately while meeting challenging regulatory requirements. You’ll partner deeply with property management and screening platforms (e.g., Yardi, Appfolio, SafeRent), and work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Go-To-Market. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, B2B2C environment, engages directly with market-rate property managers and affordable-housing operators, and translates their needs into impactful product requirements.

This is a hybrid full-time role (3 days per week in office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays) based in the New York Metropolitan area, reporting to the Head of Product. We welcome candidates willing to relocate- we provide relocation support to make your move smooth.

WITHIN THE FIRST MONTH, YOU'LL:
bullets: Get deep on the Property Management vertical, learning the fundamentals of the Property Management industry and their use cases for Nova Credit’s product platform..
Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, GTM, and Solutions Architecture.
Listen in on calls with market-rate property managers and affordable-housing operators, and review customer feedback to understand their pain points and needs.
Dive into product metrics and company KPIs to find areas for improvement.
Deliver on at least 1 key feature from the roadmap, while making a preliminary assessment on longer-term goals and priorities.

sections.title: WITHIN THE FIRST QUARTER, YOU'LL:
bullets: Have a clear understanding of Nova Credit’s business model, the property management landscape and customer needs across market-rate and affordable housing, as well as competitors.
Define and own the prioritized roadmap for the Property Management vertical that is aligned with company goals and our product vision.
Set quarterly product goals for the vertical.

sections.title: WITHIN THE FIRST YEAR, YOU'LL:
bullets: Become the subject matter expert for Nova Credit’s Property Management vertical.
Launch and iterate on multiple initiatives across our product platform with demonstrated impact to key metrics like adoption and conversion.
Deepen integrations and partnerships with property management and screening platforms.
Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic cross-functional partners and key customers.
Refresh the product strategy for the vertical while contributing to annual roadmapping and Nova Credit’s long-term product vision.

sections.title: YOUR SKILLSET:
bullets: 6+ years in product management (8+ for Staff), B2B or B2B2C, with a proven track record of shipping high-performing products.
PropTech / property management background. Direct experience in property management, tenant screening, or affordable housing. (Strongly preferred.)
Comfort with regulated spaces. You treat compliance such as FCRA / CRA obligations and affordable-housing program requirements as a first-class product concern.
Data fluency. You write your own SQL queries and build Mixpanel dashboards to inform your decisions.
Customer obsession. You talk to customers constantly and synthesize their insights with quantitative data to drive strategy and prioritization.
Cross-functional range. You navigate technical trade-offs with Engineering, debate UX approaches with Design, tie prioritization to revenue for GTM, and communicate complex concepts to any audience.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

sections.title: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.
paras: We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.
Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: Planet is seeking a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Defense and Intelligence (D&I) product portfolio. As the product leader for our fastest-growing business segment, you will define the strategy, build the roadmap, and drive the execution of our flagship dual-use products, including our Global Monitoring Service (GMS), Marine Domain Awareness (MDA) platforms, automated change detection feeds, and agentic workflows.

You will manage a dedicated team of product managers and partner directly with the Vice President of D&I Engineering and executive leadership to transform raw satellite imagery and API services into scalable, mission-critical software solutions. A core component of this role is ensuring these capabilities thrive as dual-use solutions, leveraging Planet’s commercial platform to meet rigorous national security requirements. Your work will directly empower government, allied mission partners, and enterprise customers to make critical, time-sensitive decisions.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco, CA or Arlington, VA office 3 days per week.

sections.title: Impact You'll Own:
bullets: Work seamlessly on a daily basis with the D&I Engineering leadership, UX researchers, account executives, product marketing managers, and external government stakeholders to align product strategy with engineering execution sprints and system designs.

Build dual-use tools that monitor geopolitical events, ensure marine security, and protect critical infrastructure. Your work aligns perfectly with Planet's core value of using space to help life on Earth while driving both our commercial and government ecosystems forward.

sections.title: What You Bring:
bullets: Typically 10+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years of supervisory/leadership experience in the defense, intelligence, geospatial, or aerospace sectors.

Demonstrated track record of scaling end-to-end dual-use or defense software applications (such as domain awareness, automated change detection, or spatial monitoring platforms) from concept to launch.
Comprehensive knowledge of Defense and Intelligence mission frameworks, workflows, and user needs, specifically regarding broad area monitoring and Marine Domain Awareness (MDA).
Experience collaborating directly with executive engineering leadership to translate high-level market vision and defense mission requirements into scalable engineering roadmaps.
Familiarity with navigating product development within environments governed by International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).

Proof is the service-of-process marketplace modernizing how legal documents move through the real world. 10,000 law firms, from small practices to the AmLaw 100, trust us with documents that have legal consequences: a serve has to reach the right person, at the right address, under the right rules, with a court-ready affidavit proving what happened.

sections.title: The role
paras:
Due process starts at a door. Before a lawsuit can move forward, the person being sued has to be properly notified, and for thousands of cases every day, that happens through a process server using our mobile app. It's one of the most critical steps in the litigation system.

As a Product Manager on the Server Experience and Fulfilment team, you'll own the product experience that helps those servers get it right and on time, from understanding requirements and planning attempts to capturing reliable evidence of service. Your goal is to make that work easier for servers, more predictable for the law firms relying on it, and more profitable for our marketplace overall.

sections.title: What you'll own
bullets: Planning and attempts. How servers plan their day, sequence attempts, work high-volume addresses, and see which jobs are at risk before a deadline passes.
Job requirements. Helping servers act on each job's legal requirements at the right moment, across states and counties.
Evidence of service. The capture and verification behind every attempt: location, time, photos, eligibility checks. Raise the quality bar without slowing servers down, even with no signal.
Fewer handoffs. Deciding what belongs in the app, what AI and automation can handle, and what still needs one of our service specialists.
Efficient dispatch. How job offers get packaged, priced, and distributed to servers, and the product systems behind server pay.

sections.title: Your team and scope
paras:
You're joining an established team that has driven some of Proof's biggest wins over the last two years. It moves quickly, ships with impact, and has built a best-in-class mobile app for process servers.

You'll report to the CPO and, as a hands-on IC, partner with a dedicated engineering squad and our design team on discovery, analysis, and delivery. You're accountable for the squad's multi-quarter roadmap. Day to day, you'll work side by side with a world-class operations team that handles server recruitment, rate negotiation, and risk and compliance, and with four other PMs who lead the law firm experience, platform automation, filing, and integrations.

sections.title: What success looks like in year one
bullets: More jobs meet their service deadlines, without more avoidable reattempts.
Less avoidable specialist work per job, with service quality continuing to improve.
More complete, trustworthy evidence from the field, and fewer downstream corrections caused by missing or incorrect server inputs.
Servers find the work easier, and it shows in retention: more of our best servers stay active and take on more jobs.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As the Senior Product Manager for Verified Audience, you will own one of Prove's newest product lines, from early revenue to scale. Verified Audience lets lenders and merchants recognize a real, verified consumer the moment they arrive on a website, without asking them to log in or fill out a form, and make them a personalized offer in real time. The first use case is firm offers of credit: a consumer browsing a credit card page sees that they are pre-approved, instead of a generic "Apply now" button.

The product sits where identity, credit and marketing meet. It is delivered with a major credit bureau partner and is bought from customers' marketing and acquisition budgets rather than their fraud or identity budgets. You will define the roadmap, run the product side of our partnerships, and prove to customers that the product drives measurable conversion lift.

You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Business Development, Sales and Marketing, and with Prove's executive team, since Verified Audience is a company-level priority.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Own the Verified Audience strategy, roadmap and requirements end to end, from matching an anonymous visitor to a verified identity through to the real-time offer the consumer sees.
Run the product side of our credit bureau partnership and other data and channel partners, including joint requirements, integration plans, launch readiness and performance reviews.
Move early customers from beta to production, and define the metrics that show the product's value, such as pre-approval rate, conversion lift and revenue per verified visitor.
Set pricing and packaging with Finance and Sales for a product sold into marketing and acquisition budgets.
Expand the product beyond credit cards into personal lending, buy now pay later and merchant financing, and evaluate adjacent channels such as programmatic audiences and identity graph partners.
Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy and Information Security so the product meets FCRA, GLBA, mobile carrier and consumer privacy requirements.
Create the product documentation that doesn't exist yet: architecture, data flows, partner and carrier approval requirements, and customer-facing integration guides.
Work with Engineering and Data Science to manage the backlog, write clear requirements, and deliver on time.

sections.title: About the role
paras: For more than a decade, LTK has helped shape the creator economy by connecting thousands of creators and brands with millions of consumers. Today, our platform powers more than $6 billion in annual retail sales. Behind that scale is over a decade of commerce data on how people discover products, how creators influence purchasing decisions, and how brands and consumers connect.

As Principal Product Manager, AI, you’ll use that foundation to shape the next generation of creator and agentic commerce. You’ll define how AI helps brands find the right creators, turns commerce intelligence into better decisions, and enables agents to work on behalf of customers—always with their goals in mind. Your scope will span LTK’s Creator Management Platform (CMP) agent harness and LLM judges, in-house ML models, and the proprietary knowledge graph connecting our creator, brand, campaign, and marketplace intelligence.

This is a deeply technical role and one of LTK’s most senior individual contributor product positions, paired directly with our Machine Learning and Data Science team. You’ll work together to define model capabilities, shape data and system requirements, establish rigorous evaluations, and make trade-offs across quality, reliability, latency, and cost. With influence across product strategy, technical direction, and investment decisions, you’ll turn LTK’s data and relationships into products that change how creators build businesses, brands reach customers, and consumers shop.

sections.title: How you will make an impact
bullets: Define the long-term vision and multi-quarter AI product strategy for LTK’s proprietary ML models, agent infrastructure, and evaluation systems, including the agent harness for our customer-facing experiences, LLM judges, and proprietary knowledge graph.

Define how agents understand customer goals and act on their behalf , including the tools and information they can access, when they need approval, and how customers understand, control, and override their actions. Build privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight into these experiences.

Own product evaluation and launch criteria , partnering with Machine Learning and Data Science to build representative evaluation datasets, investigate failures, and monitor quality in production across task success, reliability, latency, and cost.

Raise the bar for AI evaluation across LTK . Stay close to emerging research and industry guidance on evaluating non-deterministic experiences, test new approaches, and evolve shared frameworks, tools, and quality standards. Help other PMs build effective evaluations and strengthen launch readiness and production monitoring.
Champion responsible AI development, balancing innovation with reliability, privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
Elevate AI-native product thinking across teams, influencing senior leaders and helping shape LTK's long-term AI opportunities.

sections.title: What you will bring to LTK
bullets: 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex technical products, multi-quarter strategy, and demonstrated influence on product direction and business outcomes across teams.
Demonstrated experience shipping and improving AI/ML products in production, including LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows, with measurable customer adoption and business impact.

Strong technical fluency and experience working directly with ML engineers and applied scientists to define model requirements, guide experiments, and translate results into product decisions. You can point to concrete contributions involving model behavior, system architecture, data quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Hands-on experience using prototypes, evaluation tools, and data analysis to validate product ideas, diagnose AI behavior, and improve product quality.

Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify valuable AI opportunities, translate complex technical capabilities into intuitive customer experiences, and balance innovation with business priorities and technical constraints.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives, influencing strategic product and investment decisions, and building alignment with senior leaders without direct authority.
Understanding of responsible AI product development, including reliability, privacy, safety, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

bullets: Develop and execute strategic account plans by understanding customer objectives, stakeholder priorities, business challenges, and growth potential, ensuring clear account strategies, engagement plans, and measurable business outcomes.

Build and strengthen strategic customer relationships across operational, technical, and executive stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor to maintain alignment with customer priorities, increase engagement, and strengthen long-term partnerships.

Lead regular strategic account reviews to assess customer objectives, value realization, adoption, account health, risks, opportunities, and agreed actions, ensuring proactive management and continuous improvement of the customer relationship.

Drive customer value and adoption by monitoring usage, adoption, satisfaction, and business impact, identifying barriers to value realization and coordinating actions that enable customers to achieve measurable outcomes from the solution.

Own renewal readiness and retention activities by anticipating risks, addressing customer concerns, communicating realized value, and coordinating internal stakeholders to support successful contract continuation and maximizing customer lifetime value.

Identify and develop account growth opportunities by anticipating evolving customer needs, qualifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and partnering with relevant teams to align solutions with customer business challenges and commercial objectives.

Orchestrate cross-functional customer outcomes by coordinating Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, effective issue resolution, consistent customer experience, and delivery against agreed commitments.

Translate customer and market insights into business action by capturing and prioritizing customer feedback, market trends, product requirements, risks, and opportunities, maintaining accurate account reporting and forecasts, and influencing relevant internal teams and decisions.

sections.title: Education or equivalent professional knowledge:
bullets: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Food Science, Food Safety, Regulatory Affairs or a related field. Additional qualifications in strategic account management, consultative selling, food safety or regulatory compliance would be advantageous.

sections.title: Relevant experience:
bullets: Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS, key account management, customer success, consultative sales, or business development, ideally within a complex B2B or technology environment.
Proven experience managing strategic and multinational accounts, including account planning, customer engagement, renewals, and account growth.
Strong executive stakeholder management experience, with the ability to navigate complex customer environments and operate independently.

sections.title: Languages:
bullets: English — professional working proficiency, written and spoken.
